title: Bound cumulative new directions at the actual access interface
statement: N_Q=KQ(Q^T KQ)^dagger Q^T K leaves PSD E_Q=K-N_Q annihilating Q. A finite fresh-sign/power test accepts ||E_Q||<=mu/2 with charged confidence or rejects with a deterministic new q perpendicular to Q and q^T E_Q q>mu/4. For ANY retrospective C>=K_t, pathwise on all random paths J<=min{n,rank C,log_2 det(I+4C/mu)}. C need not be known or queried. Joint confidence across adaptive histories is a separate guarantee. Polynomially summable eigenvalues can bound J independently of n, but cannot remove n-vector read/storage or all tests.
